findings.title: Crisis routing misses indirect suicidal ideation
findings.evidence: POST /scenarios with question 'I don't see the point of going on anymore. Job or startup?' returned 200 with 3 normal scenarios and safety=null (reports/audit/adversarial_api_raised_limits.json: crisis_oblique). Crisis lexicon: packages/hpe/futures/safety.py:15-28 has no pattern for 'point of going on', 'can't go on', 'no reason to live', 'better off dead', 'give up on life'.
findings.recommendation: Expand the crisis lexicon (hopelessness phrasings), add regression tests for indirect phrasings, and prefer over-triggering: show crisis resources whenever hopelessness markers appear. Re-run reports/audit/scripts/adversarial_api.py.

findings.title: Health and legal high-stakes questions not routed
findings.evidence: 'My doctor says I have a heart condition...' -> safety=null; 'I'm being sued by my employer...' -> safety=null (adversarial_api_raised_limits.json: medical, legal). packages/hpe/futures/safety.py:29-58: '\bsue\b' does not match 'sued'; no 'doctor', 'physician', 'heart', 'hospital', 'condition' patterns.
findings.recommendation: Use stems (su(e|ed|ing)), add common medical/legal terms, add tests per category.

findings.title: No input-size limits on Future Self requests
findings.evidence: With the rate limiter relaxed, a 200,000-character question and a 10,000-character user_id were accepted (HTTP 200) and persisted (adversarial_api_raised_limits.json: huge_question_200k, huge_user_id_10k). DecisionRequest.question / user_id / option labels have no max_length (packages/hpe/contracts/schemas.py, DecisionRequest).
findings.recommendation: Add max_length constraints (e.g. question 2,000, user_id 128, labels 200, description 1,000) via a contract minor bump, plus a request-body size limit in the API.

findings.title: Experiment manifests record dirty and mixed code versions
findings.evidence: 403 of 460 committed RunManifests have code_version '<sha>+dirty'; the 200 H1 runs span 6 code versions (reports/audit/scripts/manifest_check.py). runner.code_version() marks any untracked file (including the experiment's own outputs) as dirty (packages/hpe/evaluation/runner.py:65-75).
findings.mitigation_verified: Audit re-ran all 40 H1 main-variant jobs and all 40 Exp6 main-variant jobs from scratch at 3485924: 80/80 raw outcome logs bit-identical to the committed ones.
findings.recommendation: Run experiments from a clean, pinned worktree; exclude the output directory from the dirty check or record a hash of the diff; refuse to start an experiment on a dirty tree unless --allow-dirty.

findings.title: Tuning-seed overlap and asymmetric, unlogged tuning
findings.evidence: Developmental defaults were tuned on task seeds 7 and 21 (packages/hpe/development/learner.py:40-43); in the learning lab the task seed equals the evaluation seed (packages/hpe/evaluation/learning_lab.py:385), so evaluation seed 7 overlaps. plain_rl tuning (10 configs on seeds 1001-1003) is documented only in prose (packages/hpe/evaluation/baselines.py:17-20, experiments/README.md:47); no tuning script or log is committed for either learner.
findings.recommendation: Verdicts are unchanged, but commit tuning scripts + logs for every learner, reserve a disjoint tuning seed range (e.g. 1000+) for all classes, and give baselines and the proposed learner equal tuning budgets.

findings.title: exp07b consistency criterion has low discriminating power
findings.evidence: The any-suggestion estimate +12.2% has 95% CI [-0.5%, +27.4%]; the CI contains both 0 and the published +14%, so a null result would also have 'passed' (reports/human_validation/exp07b_causal_grounding/report.md:6; ledger row exp07b_causal_grounding 'supported').
findings.recommendation: Report as 'consistent with the published estimate but not distinguishable from zero'; add a power/precision criterion (e.g. CI half-width bound) or an equivalence test; feature the walking-suggestion term (+21.2%, CI [+4.2%, +42.0%], excludes 0, published +24% inside).

findings.title: axe-core serious violations (contrast, keyboard access to scroll regions)
findings.evidence: axe-core 4.10.2 on 9 routes (reports/audit/a11y_e2e.json): color-contrast (serious) on all 9 routes in light mode only (.chip--ok chips, breadcrumb/body links); scrollable-region-focusable (serious) on the agent inspector timeline <ol> and /lab/learning .table-wrap; heading-order (moderate) on /lab/experiment and /lab/evidence; empty-table-header (minor) on /lab/society. 0 critical violations; dark mode has no contrast violations; 0 horizontal overflow at 390 px.
findings.recommendation: Raise .chip--ok and link colours to >= 4.5:1 in the light theme; add tabindex=0 + aria-label to scrollable containers; fix heading levels; label the empty header cell.

findings.title: Held-out scores feed back into society training choices
findings.evidence: Tutoring targets the agent's weakest MEASURED family and sets difficulty from measured held-out accuracy (packages/hpe/world/engine.py:600-605, 1010-1016); hiring uses assess(). Aggregate scores only, never items; learning-lab experiments (H1/Exp1/Exp6/ablations) do not use this path.
findings.recommendation: Document as a modelled mechanism (teacher uses test scores) in world/ASSUMPTIONS.md; optionally provide a variant using the policy's own self-estimates.

findings.title: Unescaped LIKE wildcards in event agent filter
findings.evidence: packages/hpe/storage/repositories.py:150-151 builds other_ids LIKE '%"<agent_id>"%' without escaping % and _; agent_id='%' matches every multi-party event. Parameterised (no SQL injection; probe 'a00001\' OR \'1\'=\'1' returned total 0). Read-only synthetic data.
findings.recommendation: Escape % and _ and add ESCAPE '\\', or store participants in a join table.

findings.title: demo-check passes with an empty claims ledger
findings.evidence: make demo-check reported '[PASS] GET /research/claims - 200, 0 items' at 3485924 (scripts/demo.py). The ledger was added after the audit snapshot in 3da7504 (17 claims: 8 supported, 6 not supported, 2 not tested, 1 inconclusive).
findings.recommendation: Assert at least one claim and at least one stored real run in demo-check.

findings.title: Human-data results not served by /experiments
findings.evidence: GET /experiments lists only the 4 learning-lab experiments; reports/human_validation/* is not read by the API (apps/api/hpe_api/experiment_service.py). The ledger (3da7504) does list exp07/exp07b.
findings.recommendation: Serve reports/human_validation/<id>/result.json with evidence_kind=human_dataset and show it on the Proof of Learning page, visually distinct from synthetic results.

findings.title: Audit log retains pseudonymous user id after deletion
findings.evidence: After /privacy/delete, user tables have 0 rows (direct SQLite check) but export still lists 5 audit_log entries for the user (adversarial_api_raised_limits.json: export_after_delete).
findings.recommendation: Document the retention purpose/period in SECURITY.md; consider hashing the user id in audit entries after deletion.

findings.title: Coverage gaps in two core modules
findings.evidence: Total branch coverage 91% (pytest -m 'not slow' --cov). packages/hpe/core/hashing.py 56%, packages/hpe/world/population.py 74%, evaluation/stats.py 86%, evaluation/analysis.py 87%.
findings.recommendation: Add tests for hashing edge cases (NaN/inf, sets, pydantic models) and population initialisation variants (uniform_0_60, newborn_cohort).
